/customers.description:
This API allows to manage past and recurring customers.
Very useful when tracking and managing charges belonging to the same customer.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of customers.

post.description: This operation is used to created a new customer.

get.description: Retrieve a customer by their Id.

put.description: Updates customer's details such as name, address etc...

delete.description: Delete a customer by their Id

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-Api-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description:
An API key is a token that a client provides when making API calls.

API keys are supposed to be a secret that only the client and server know about.

OAuth2.description:
OAuth 2.0 is an authorization protocol that gives an API client limited access to user data on a web server.

OAuth relies on authentication scenarios, that allows the resource owner (user) to share the protected content from the server, hosting the resource, without sharing their credentials. For that purpose, an OAuth 2.0 server issues access tokens that the client applications can use to access protected resources on behalf of the resource owner.

Moneris recommends the use of OAuth 2.0 as it provides fine grained authorization levels.

parameterError.title: Parameter error
parameterError.description: Request property or header related error.

parameterName.description: Property or header name. Can contain nested path separated by '.'

parameterValue.description: Property or header value string representation.

errorMessage.description: Human readable description of the error.
errorMessage.example: String 'MAP3J8' does not match the postal code pattern.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.  Ideally it should be a stable URL to the documentation of the details about this type of error but it also can be a URN.  If nothing can be provided, a "about:blank" value is returned.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.   It SHOULD NOT change from occurrence to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization

status.description: it conveys the HTTP status code used for the convenience of the consumer.

detail.description: A human-readable message providing more details about the error. For card errors, these messages can be shown to your users.
detail.example: Funds are insufficient to execute the operation.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem. Typically, this resolves to a resource that might include more details about the problem.

category.description:
The type of error returned. 
 - `API_ERROR`: This occurs due to an intermittent issue.  
 - `IDEMPOTENCY_ERROR`: The idempotency key has already been used.
 - `INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR`: The data provided in the request is invalid.
 - `DECLINED_ERROR`: Transaction was declined by the issuer.
 - `UNAUTHORIZED_ERROR`: Caller not authenticated, or not allowed to execute the current operation.
 - `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR`: An internal issue with our servers has occured.

errors.description: List of validation errors when error category is INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR.

example.errorMessage: address.Postal code does not match regular expression

idempotencyKey.description:
A Unique Identifier that is required for handling idempotent requests. 

Note: Moneris encourages the use of UUID Version 4 in APIs as an idempotency key."

sunset.description:
Optional.

Indicates that the resource URI will be decommissioned, and put out of service at the specified point in the future. 
More details are available at [RFC 8594](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8594.html)

rateLimitRemaining.description: The number of requests allowed in the current window.

rateLimitReset.description: The relative time in seconds when the rate limit window will be reset.

retryAfter.description: Indicates how long clients should wait before retrying.
